decisions.mark: identifies the buffer allocator (MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C) as the only in-tree user of the runtime setter, installing itself over the pointers from its init function
decisions.detail: QUOTE: "It uses the facility to install its own allocator. `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`) takes a caller-supplied buffer, sets up an in-buffer heap that never calls `calloc`/`free`, and registers itself with `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`." | WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init registers itself via the setter, but it never says it is the only in-tree user.
